items.caption: This bronze-style form of 毛 has a central vertical stroke with branching, curved strokes on both sides. It illustrates the hair-like pictographic interpretation; the precise referent is uncertain.
items.alt: Bold black glyph with a long central vertical stroke and curved side strokes branching outward, on a white background.
items.selection_reason: The visible branching form helps illustrate the sourced pictographic analysis of 毛 as hair, while the evidence does not establish one precise depicted object.

limitations.text: The graph is interpreted as depicting human or animal hair, and some accounts also describe it as a feather. The available evidence does not identify one precise original referent or establish the first attested form.
